brand.name: CV Maker
marketing.hero.title: Build a CV that gets you hired
marketing.hero.subtitle: A fast, guided CV builder with four polished templates, real autosave, and a free export for everyone. No credit card, no catch.
marketing.trust.eyebrow: Built for how hiring actually works
marketing.trust.title: No binary gender fields. No hidden paywalls. No lost drafts.
marketing.features.title: Everything a modern CV needs, none of the friction
marketing.features.autosave.title: Autosave, always
marketing.features.autosave.body: Every field saves itself about a second after you stop typing, with a visible "Saved" indicator. Never a silent save button you forgot to click.
marketing.features.templates.title: Four real templates
marketing.features.templates.body: Not palette swaps. Four distinct, professionally designed layouts, each with its own curated color palette.
marketing.features.inclusive.title: Genuinely inclusive fields
marketing.features.inclusive.body: An open gender field, a dynamic birth-year range, and free-text driving licence and marital status fields that don't force you into a box.
marketing.features.bilingual.title: Bilingual by design
marketing.features.bilingual.body: Write your CV in Portuguese or English, independent of the language your builder interface is in.
marketing.features.honest.title: An honest progress bar
marketing.features.honest.body: Our builder shows all four steps, including checkout. You'll never hit a payment screen the navigation never warned you about.
marketing.features.export.title: Export whenever you like
marketing.features.export.body: Download a free, watermarked PDF at any point. Upgrade only when you want the watermark gone or a premium template.
marketing.freemium.title: Free means free, not a trial with a countdown
marketing.freemium.body: Create an account, build your whole CV, and export a real, watermarked PDF whenever you want, for as long as you want. Paying removes the watermark and unlocks two premium templates. That's the entire pitch.
marketing.freemium.free.title: Free
marketing.freemium.free.body: Unlimited CVs, all sections, two starter templates, and unlimited watermarked PDF exports.
marketing.freemium.pro.title: Pro
marketing.freemium.pro.body: Everything in Free, plus watermark-free exports and two additional premium templates.
marketing.cta.title: Your next job starts with a CV that looks the part
marketing.cta.body: It takes about ten minutes. It's free to start, and free to finish.
footer.tagline: CV Maker is built and maintained by Flathire.
pricing.title: One free plan. One upgrade. No surprises.
pricing.subtitle: Every account can build unlimited CVs and export them for free, with a small watermark. Upgrade any time to remove it and unlock premium templates.
pricing.free.name: Free
pricing.pro.name: Pro
pricing.faq.title: Common questions
pricing.faq.q1: Is the free plan really free?
pricing.faq.a1: Yes. There's no trial period and no credit card required to sign up, build a CV, or export it as a watermarked PDF.
pricing.faq.q2: What does the watermark look like?
pricing.faq.a2: A small, discreet "Made with CV Maker" mark in the page footer, never over your content.
pricing.faq.q3: Can I cancel Pro at any time?
pricing.faq.a3: Yes, from your account at any time. You keep Pro access until the end of the period you already paid for.
